author: VegetasBulge
quote:
This is what happens when your game is made by a Gen Z boss in a mini. All jokes aside it feels like an HR consulting firm micro managed the creation of GTA 6. 

One thing I do want to thank Rockstar for though. Showing me how unbelievably corrupt of a corp you are by using your influence to lobby for perfect 10/10 reviews from so called "journalist" who decided to sell their integrity to promote your politically correct slop. Everyone involved in this travesty should honestly be ashamed of themselves. Including the devs themselves. Either way, GTA 6 is where creativity and innovation dies. Especially for the franchise. Anyway lets get to the meat of the review. Im going to be giving this game a 10/10 in spirit so daddy Rockstar is happy.

The game is capped at 30 fps (Thanks for the rug pull 9 days prior Rockstar 10/10 move)

The game is tedious and boring (Thanks rockstar for the painting simulator. Cant wait to go nail in some boards later. You sure know how to have fun 10/10)

Bugs bugs and bugs! Love clipping through the map! (Amazinng work Rockstar 10/10)

Realism in this game is incredible. Its what I came for. Most realistic thing in this game so far is that a mother can be sent to jail for a violent crime and the father still cant get custody. (Who ever wrote this story 10/10 job. You are up there with the greats like Stephen King and George RR Martin. I mean its absolutely captivating and culture shifting. You should feel proud of your self. Seriously 10/10)

Graphics are great... especially in 20 fps dips. 10/10 graphics

Combat is cool, when the game says you can have combat. Love it when I play a game known historically for mayhem, but I cant run over protesters? Shoot my gun in a club? Or do anything GTA related. 10/10 game design. 

Seriously, Rockstar dev team, what the ****
